sources.private_binding_table: Interface/FrameXML/Bindings.xml in the local 1.12.1 patch chain

implementation: Authored Rust reimplementation of documented input modes and reference parameters; no reference implementation copied.

bindings.A and Left: turn left; strafe left during right mouselook
bindings.D and Right: turn right; strafe right during right mouselook

parameters.camera_follow: Smart; cosine yaw transition, duration abs(offset)/180 degrees per second clamped to 0.1–2 seconds

checks: cargo test -p verse --no-default-features --features imported-desktop: 319 passed, 8 existing ignored; 7 integration tests passed
Native winit surface and owned renderer --proof capture completed

Control tests cover normal turn vs right-button strafe, left orbit, steering alignment, both buttons, opposing keys, autorun edge cancellation, pointer-mode reset, rate law, camera return frame independence, zoom glide, reverse speed, diagonal speed, and screen-space strafe direction
animation_correction: The previous utility demo used ShuffleRight (12) for Grease; current gameplay uses the client Sleep pose (100). The earlier video remains retained evidence of that earlier revision.
limitations: OS acceleration and device pointer units differ from the Windows client; physical mouse travel has not been calibrated against a live client.
Chamber floor bounds remain local; imported-dungeon camera collision, jumping, swimming, and user-configurable CVars are outside this control change.
Native UI automation cannot bind the unbundled example; mouse dispatch was code-reviewed and controller transitions were exercised through tests.
